STEP_LIMITS = {'text': 500, 'cmd': 1000, 'link': 500}

def _step(raw: object) -> dict | None:
    """One human-task step {id, text, cmd, link}, or None if it breaks the schema."""
    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or not isinstance(raw.get('id'), str) or (not STEP_RE.fullmatch(raw['id'])):
        return None
    out = {'id': raw['id']}
    for k, limit in STEP_LIMITS.items():
        v = raw.get(k, '')
        if not isinstance(v, str) or len(v.strip()) > limit:
            return None
        out[k] = v.strip()
    return out if out['text'] else None

def clean_steps(raw: object) -> list[dict]:
    """Valid steps of a card or note `steps` list; invalid entries are dropped."""
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        return []
    return [s for s in map(_step, raw) if s]

def classify_page(name: str) -> str:
    n = name.lower()
    if '-pre' in n:
        return 'pre'
    if '-post' in n:
        return 'post'
    if 'mockup' in n:
        return 'mockup'
    return 'display'
